summary: Good day and a clean turnaround from Monday. Your pre-market said wait for a retrace and then long toward the 4hr UMG, and that's what you did: price pulled back into the 5min 0.5-0.618 zone at D OPEN right around 10:00, swept the internal low, and you longed off the 1min SMT with the stop under that low. One XFA account, NY-AM, logged as a win at 3.02R. The one real miss is the exit: you planned the 4hr UMG (~29,759), then cut it at NYAM.H because 1min volume faded, which AB called out too. Your own notes also show the old pull toward PNL ("risked like 180 instead of 250").
trade: Long · NY-AM · XFA x1 · Win (3.02R) · Entry ~29,543 just after 10:00, stop ~29,495 under the swept internal low, closed at NYAM.H (~29,688) instead of the planned 4hr UMG (~29,759)
rule: When the HTF target from pre-market is still valid, don't close early because 1min volume slows. Only exit early if price sweeps NYAM.H and then consolidates or rejects; otherwise take a partial at NYAM.H and leave the rest on the planned target.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 1 · 4hr ES + NQ (9:27 AM)
screenshots.feedback: Your fib runs from the ~30,080 high down to the ~28,975 low, and NQ is sitting right at the 0.5 with PD-H. The 29,759 line you call the 4hr UMG sits at about the 0.705, so a long to it is a long into premium of a bearish 4hr leg. That's a fair retrace target, but it explains why you got nervous holding it.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 2 · 1hr ES + NQ (9:27 AM)
screenshots.feedback: Both ES and NQ are pushing into their PD-H at the same time, so there's no clear divergence up here yet. Price had a strong bullish leg off PD-EQ overnight, which matches your note that last night gave another bullish leg. A retrace before continuation was a reasonable read.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 3 · 15m ES + NQ (9:27 AM)
screenshots.feedback: NQ already took AS.H and poked above PD-H in the London/pre-market push, then dipped back under it by 9:27. D OPEN (~29,490) and LO.H are the obvious levels underneath, and that's exactly where the retrace you were waiting for ended up.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 4 · 5min ES + NQ (9:28 AM)
screenshots.feedback: Best prep chart of the day. You drew the fib on the overnight leg and shaded the 0.5-0.618 zone (~29,480-29,520) right on top of D OPEN before the open. That's a specific, pre-planned area, and price came back into it, so the entry wasn't a guess.

screenshots.label: Execution · 1min NQ + ES (10:39 AM)
screenshots.feedback: Entry ~29,543, stop ~29,495 under the internal low that price swept right around 10:00 at the 0.618, and the position box still runs up to ~29,760, your original target. The chart backs up your notes: 0.618 held, internal low swept, ES and NQ diverged at that low (1min SMT), then a strong 1min displacement. At 10:39 price had already spiked toward NYAM.H and was at ~29,617.

good: Pre-market plan matched the trade: you said wait for a retrace and then long, and you waited for the retrace into your pre-drawn 5min 0.5-0.618 zone at D OPEN.
You didn't enter before 10:00. The low at the 0.618 printed around 10:00 and the entry came after it, with confirmation (swept internal low, 1min SMT, displacement).
Stop sat under the low that was swept and formed the SMT, which is a protected low, not an internal level like Monday's stop.
One XFA account, NY-AM session, no copying the trade across evals. No eval purchase emails today.
Risk was under your normal size (~$180 vs $250), so no over-risking, and you locked out after the win instead of looking for more.
You logged AB's feedback in detail again, including the part that goes against you (closing early).
fix: Exit vs plan: your target was the 4hr UMG (~29,759), and your Entry type even says 'depending on volume i might hold to 27,759' (probably a typo for 29,759). You closed at NYAM.H on 1min volume. AB's point is right: low volume or slow delivery doesn't make the idea invalid.

You wrote that a strong sweep of NYAM.H with volume would give you conviction. Decide that rule before the trade, not during it. Right now the exit was made on a feeling ('a bit nervous i dont want to get BE').

PNL focus: 'upset i risked like 180 instead of 250'. You won, followed the plan, and the first thing you graded was the dollar amount. You named it yourself, which is good, but it's the same thing you admitted on Monday.
Fear from last week is steering exits: 'after taking a big L last week on my account i decided to play it safe'. Playing it safe is fine, but do it with a partial, not by abandoning the target.
StopLoss says 'Smt'd low'. Add the actual price (~29,495) so each trade can be graded from your own numbers.

questions.q: You wrote 'if this trade were to sweep NYAM with volume and closed strong it would've gave me more conviction to hold'. AB says it took NYAM.H and kept going. What exactly would you need to see at NYAM.H tomorrow to hold, and what would make you close?

You're upset you risked ~$180 instead of $250 on a trade you won. If the same setup had lost, would you be glad it was $180? What does that tell you about whether size should change with how you feel?

'After taking a big L last week on my account i decided to play it safe.' Is last week's loss going to decide how you manage FOMC tomorrow? What's your plan for FOMC, and will you wait until after 2:30 PM like AB suggested?
Would a partial at NYAM.H and a runner to 29,759 have solved both the nerves and the early exit? If yes, why wasn't that the plan before entry?
questions.answer: Yeah i thought about it but AB always says whats the point if we need to be targetting DOL an if we are partialing were basically saying our TP is at a area we are uncertain itll hit when we need to be executing with certincy
